title: Reporting Write Destination
description: Storage or warehouse destination for durable reporting. The caller either references an existing seller-issued binding or asks the seller to validate and bind a provider-native location. The seller verifies authenticated-caller authority for the account/feed/scope and destination control before readiness. A destination_ref is bound to that caller/account and cannot be probed or reused across scopes. Access grants name advertised producer identities; credentials never transit AdCP.

destination_ref.description: Seller-issued reference returned by an earlier sync or bilateral setup.

location.description: Provider-native bucket, prefix, project/dataset, catalog/schema, or equivalent locator. It MUST NOT contain an embedded credential or signed URL.

access_mode.description: Optional provider access family used for capability matching.

x-adcp-validation.authorization: Bind every destination_ref to the authenticated caller and resolved account. Reject unknown, unauthorized, cross-caller, and cross-account refs indistinguishably.
x-adcp-validation.destination_proof: Before ready, prove destination control and caller authority for every selected feed and media-buy scope. Revoke grants when the configuration, caller authorization, or account becomes inactive.
